import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = data[1:1 + n]
    b = data[1 + n:1 + 2 * n]
    # a[i]-b[j] == a[j]-b[i]  <=>  a[i]+b[i] == a[j]+b[j]
    cnt = {}
    ans = 0
    for x, y in zip(a, b):
        key = int(x) + int(y)
        c = cnt.get(key, 0) + 1
        cnt[key] = c
        ans += c  # pairs (i, j) with i <= j ending at j, including i == j
    print(ans)


main()
